Task: Pack-And-Go Frittata Sandwiches Recipe by Tasty
Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180˚C). 
Step 2: Brush a 9x9-inch (23x23-cm) baking dish with the olive oil. 
Step 3: In a medium bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, and chives. Season with salt and pepper. 
Step 4: Add the egg mixture to the baking dish and bake until just set in the middle, 15-20 minutes. Cut into 9 squares. 
Step 5: For kids, layer one slice of cheese on top of one of the English muffin halves. Top with a frittata square. Spread the remaining English muffin half with mustard, and sandwich together. 
Step 6: For adults, layer one slice of cheese on top of one of the English muffin halves. Top with a frittata square, roasted red pepper slices, and arugula. Spread the remaining English muffin half with mustard, and sandwich together.

Step 5: Generously coat a standard size muffin tin with nonstick cooking spray. 
Step 6: Line each cup of prepared muffin tin with a tortilla sheet. 
Step 7: Add 1.5 tablespoons taco mixture. Top with 1 tablespoon of cheese. Press down and add another layer of tortilla sheet, taco mixture, and a final layer of cheese. 
Step 8: Lightly brush the top edges of the tortilla with cooking oil. 
Step 9: Bake 18-20 minutes until cups are heated through and edges are golden brown.

Task: Dark Chocolate Swirl Banana Bread Recipe by Tasty
Step 1: Preheat oven to 325˚F (170˚C). 
Step 2: Mash bananas in a large bowl. Add eggs and combine thoroughly. Then mix in the remaining wet ingredients: greek yogurt, maple syrup, and vanilla. 
Step 3: Next, add the whole wheat flour and baking powder and mix until fully incorporated. Be careful not to over mix. 
Step 4: In a medium, microwave-safe bowl, microwave the chocolate chunks in 30-second intervals, stirring in between, until melted and smooth. 
Step 5: Add a large scoop of the banana batter to the bowl of melted chocolate and fold until mixed well. 
Step 6: Pour the banana batter and the chocolate batter alternately into a greased 9x5-inch (23x13 cm) bread pan. These do not need to be even layers.

Task: Cheesy Buffalo Chicken Ring Recipe by Tasty
Step 1: In a bowl, mix cream cheese and hot sauce until smooth. 
Step 2: Mix in chicken and Monterey Jack cheese. 
Step 3: Unroll cans of dough, separate into triangles. On a large cookie sheet, arrange the triangles in ring, dough should overlap, leaving around 5 inches (12 ¾ cm) in the center. 
Step 4: Layer half of the Mozzarella on each triangle closest to the ring. 
Step 5: Spoon mixture on top of the Mozzarella. Top with the rest of the Mozzarella. 
Step 6: Bring the top of the triangle over the filling and tuck the edges under the bottom layer of dough. Repeat around the ring until the entire filling is enclosed. 
Step 7: Bake at 375˚F (190˚C) for 35 minutes or until the dough is golden brown. 
Step 8: Cool 5 to 10 minutes before cutting into serving slices. Serve with choice dressing.

Step 7: Cut the creme eggs in half and press firmly into the mixture. 
Step 8: Chill for at least two hours.

Task: Halloween Party Punch Recipe by Tasty
Step 1: Fill each plastic glove with water until about 2 inches (5 cm) from the opening of the glove. Twist the opening and tie into a knot. 
Step 2: Place in a tray, draping some gloves over others if you want some of the fingers to appear bent. Freeze for at least 4 hours, or overnight, until solid. 
Step 3: Make the lychee eyeballs: Place a blueberry inside each lychee. 
Step 4: Use a toothpick to paint a bit of red food coloring on the outside of the lychees to mimic veins on an eyeball. Add the lychees to a large punch bowl. 
Step 5: Pour in the cranberry juice, ginger ale, reserved lychee juice, and vodka, if using. 
Step 6: Remove the gloves from the freezer and run under warm water for 15 seconds. Use scissors to cut off the knot and then slide the ice out of each glove and into the punch. 
Step 7: To serve, ladle punch and a couple eyeballs into glasses.

Step 5: Brush around the ankles with ketchup to look like “blood.” 
Step 6: Bake for 1 hour, until the meat is cooked through. 
Step 7: Serve warm.

Task: Mandu
Step 1: Place the tofu in a small bowl lined with paper towels. Top with another paper towel and a bowl filled water for weight. Let sit for 15 minutes to extract some moisture from the tofu. 
Step 2: Crumble the tofu into small pieces in a large bowl. Add the pork, beef, scallions, onion, kimchi, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, soy sauce, salt and pepper. Mix well with your hands. 
Step 3: In a small bowl, combine the egg and water. 
Step 4: Put two teaspoons of filling in the middle of a dumpling wrapper. Using your finger, wet half of the outer rim of the wrapper with the egg and water mixture. 
Step 5: Fold the wrapper in half. Using your fingertips, start make pleats to seal the mandu. Repeat with the rest of the wrappers and filling. 
Step 6: Bring a large pot of water to boil over high heat. Once boiling, add 6-7 mandu at a time. Once the mandu start floating on the surface, boil for another 1-2 minutes. Remove the mandu from the water with a spider or slotted spoon and repeat with the rest of the dumplings. 
Step 7: Serve with dipping sauce.

Step 4: Uncover and drizzle the brown sugar mixture over the popcorn. Carefully toss to coat. 
Step 5: Sprinkle the spice mixture over the popcorn and stir to coat evenly. 
Step 6: Transfer to a bowl and eat immediately, or spread in a single layer on a baking sheet and let cool completely before storing in a sealed container for up to 2 days.

Step 6: Bake for 25 minutes or until golden brown. 
Step 7: Cut into pieces and serve with choice dressing in a bowl in the middle.

Task: Chocolate Banana Cream Sandwiches Recipe by Tasty
Step 1: In a medium mixing bowl combine the brownie mix, oil and water. Mix well. 
Step 2: On a baking sheet, lay down a sheet of wax paper. Spoon on half the mixture, and spread out to be about ½ inch (1 cm) thick. 
Step 3: Press 6 gram crackers into the mixture. Cover with remaining brownie batter. 
Step 4: Bake at 350˚F (180˚C) for 15-20 minutes until a toothpick inserted comes out clean. 
Step 5: Let it cool before slicing out the graham crackers. (There will be leftover bits of brownie in between the slices to enjoy now! Mmmm. ) 
Step 6: Freeze the rectangular slices for one hour. 
Step 7: Peel and slice 3 bananas before freezing. 
Step 8: In a blender, combine the bananas, vanilla, and maple syrup. Blend on high until creamy. 
Step 9: Use a bag to squeeze the filling onto the crust. Top with another crust.

Step 7: Drop the cooked bacon bits over the bread, pushing some of them down into the cracks.

Step 9: Bake for 18-20 minutes until the camembert is melted and the top of the bread is crusty.

Task: Tater Tot Breakfast Pizza Recipe by Tasty
Step 1: Pour the tater tots in a large mixing bowl. Microwave for one minute and forty-five seconds (or until soft) 
Step 2: Add one egg to the softened tater tots and mix. 
Step 3: Grease a cast-iron pan with butter, then pour the tater-tot mixture into the pan and spread it out to create a crust. 
Step 4: Bake the crust for 15 minutes at 400˚F (200˚C). 
Step 5: Remove from the oven, then add ½ of the cheddar cheese, ½ of the mozzarella cheese, and ½ of the bacon bits to the base of the crust. 
Step 6: Crack the rest of the eggs evenly over the top of the crust, then top with the rest of the cheese and bacon bits. 
Step 7: Bake for 15 more minutes at 400˚F (200˚C). 
Step 8: Top with avocado slices and pepper.
